# Baranova

> Baranova is a Nairobi, Kenya-based software, data, and strategy studio. It helps founders and enterprise teams design, build, and scale software and data systems, from first sketch to production, and offers the strategic advisory that ties technical decisions to business outcomes.

Baranova is a small, senior-only team (currently three people) that works as an embedded technical partner rather than a hand-off agency: every engagement is led by senior engineers and strategists, scoped with clear milestones and transparent pricing, and delivered with documentation and testing so the client team can maintain it after handoff.

## Company facts

- Name: Baranova
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya (works with clients worldwide)
- Founded by: Joseph Kariuki (Founder & Engineering Lead)
- Team: Joseph Kariuki (Founder & Engineering Lead), Mary Maina (Product & Design Lead), Hassler Juma (Data & Strategy Lead)
- Contact: hello@baranova.studio
- Website: https://ipswyworld.github.io/baranova/

## Services

- **Product Engineering**: web applications, mobile apps, and legacy system modernization.
- **Data & Analytics**: data pipelines (ETL/ELT), dashboards & BI, and applied AI/ML.
- **Strategy & Advisory**: technical due diligence, architecture review, and roadmap / fractional CTO advisory.
